info.title: Microlink API
info.description:
Microlink turns any URL into data. A single GET request drives a real browser to
extract normalized metadata, capture screenshots, generate PDFs, convert content
to markdown or text, detect media and technologies, and run Lighthouse audits.

## Endpoints

`api.microlink.io` serves unauthenticated requests with a soft limit of 25
requests/day per IP. `pro.microlink.io` serves authenticated requests, with the
quota of the plan attached to the API key.

## Rate limits

Every response carries `x-rate-limit-limit`, `x-rate-limit-remaining` and
`x-rate-limit-reset` (UTC epoch seconds). Exceeding the quota returns HTTP 429
with the `ERATE` code; wait until the reset instant before retrying.

## Errors

Responses follow the JSend specification. A failed request keeps the same shape
as a successful one and adds a machine-readable `code`, a human-readable
explanation under `data`, and links to the documentation and to a prefilled
report. Match on `code`, never on the message text.

## Versioning

The API is unversioned and additive-only: new query parameters and new response
fields ship continuously, and no change ever removes or repurposes an existing
one. A change that cannot be made additively ships as a separate endpoint rather
than as a new behaviour of this one, so an integration written today keeps
working without pinning a version.

Deprecation policy: a deprecated parameter or field is announced at
https://microlink.io/changelog at least 6 months before removal, and the affected
responses carry `Deprecation` and `Sunset` headers (RFC 9745, RFC 8594) for the
whole notice period. Nothing is deprecated today.

tags.name: extraction
tags.description: Drive a browser over a URL and return the data it produces.

get.description:
Runs the target URL through a real browser and returns the data selected by
the query parameters: normalized metadata by default, plus screenshots,
PDFs, markdown, plain text, media, technologies or Lighthouse audits when
the matching parameter is enabled.

Parameter names are accepted in camelCase and snake_case alike. Nested
options use dot notation, for example `screenshot.fullPage=true`.

parameters.name: adblock
parameters.description: Improve performance and reduce response times by blocking non-essential advertisements, trackers, and cookie banners.

parameters.name: animations
parameters.description: Control CSS animations and transitions during website rendering. Ensures consistent snapshots by handling motion effects in the headless browser.

parameters.name: audio
parameters.description: Detect and extract audio sources from any URL. It returns browser-friendly audio URLs along with metadata enabling integration of media content from platforms.

parameters.name: cacheKey
parameters.description: Take full control of cache identity to maximize hit rates and avoid redundant processing.

parameters.name: click
parameters.description: Automate browser interactions by clicking specific DOM elements via CSS selectors. Use this parameter to trigger navigation, toggle UI components, or change page state.

parameters.name: colorScheme
parameters.description: Force the browser to render websites in light or dark mode using the prefers-color-scheme CSS media feature.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Define custom data extraction rules using CSS selectors with the Microlink Query Language (MQL). Extract specific content like prices, reviews, or any structured data from any URL.

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: Emulate a wide range of mobile, tablet, and desktop devices by automatically setting the correct viewport, user agent, and screen resolution.

parameters.name: embed
parameters.description: Return a specific data field directly as the response body with appropriate content-type headers. Embed screenshots, PDFs, or extracted data directly in HTML, CSS, or Markdown.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Define a custom name for generated assets like screenshots or PDFs using the filename parameter.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Reduce response bandwidth and optimize payload size by selecting specific data fields.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Bypass the Microlink CDN cache to fetch a fresh version of the target URL. Use the force parameter to invalidate existing cached copies and ensure the most up-to-date metadata.

parameters.name: function
parameters.description: Execute custom JavaScript code inside a headless browser to perform advanced scraping or automation tasks. Gain full control over the page lifecycle with Puppeteer access.

parameters.name: headers
parameters.description: Configure custom HTTP headers to be sent with your requests to the target URL. This Pro feature allows for emulating specific browsers.

parameters.name: iframe
parameters.description: The iframe parameter returns ready-to-use HTML and script tags for hundreds of providers.

parameters.name: insights
parameters.description: Analyze web performance and stack data with Microlink Insights. Extract identified technologies via Wappalyzer and detailed Lighthouse audit reports directly from any target URL.

parameters.name: insights.lighthouse
parameters.description: Generate comprehensive Google Lighthouse reports for any URL. Export web performance audits in JSON, HTML, or CSV formats using custom configurations via Microlink API.

parameters.name: insights.technologies
parameters.description: Identify the software stack behind any URL using Microlink technology detection. It returns a detailed list of frameworks, CDNs, and analytics tools with confidence scores.

parameters.name: javascript
parameters.description: Control whether JavaScript is executed within the headless browser for a target URL.

parameters.name: mediaType
parameters.description: Switch between "screen" and "print" CSS media queries to control how a website renders for capture.

parameters.name: meta
parameters.description: Extract normalized metadata from any URL, including titles, descriptions, images, and logos.

parameters.name: modules
parameters.description: Inject JavaScript modules into a webpage during the rendering process.

parameters.name: palette
parameters.description: Extract dominant color palettes and accessibility-compliant color schemes from detected images.

parameters.name: pdf
parameters.description: Generate high-quality PDFs from any website using Microlink headless browser infrastructure.

parameters.name: pdf.format
parameters.description: Customize the paper format for PDF generation from any URL. Supports standard sizes including A4, Letter, Legal, and Tabloid for high-quality.

parameters.name: pdf.height
parameters.description: Set a custom paper height for your PDF generation using pixels, inches, or other CSS units. Fine-tune the dimensions of your website-to-PDF conversions.

parameters.name: pdf.landscape
parameters.description: Set the paper orientation to landscape for your website-to-PDF conversions. Toggle between portrait and landscape modes to optimize the layout of generated PDF documents.

parameters.name: pdf.margin
parameters.description: Configure custom paper margins for your website-to-PDF conversions. Specify unified margins or individual top, bottom, left, and right values.

parameters.name: pdf.pageRanges
parameters.description: Define specific page ranges for your website-to-PDF conversion. Extract single pages or custom intervals like "1-5, 8, 11-13" from any URL using the Microlink API pageRanges parameter.

parameters.name: pdf.scale
parameters.description: Adjust the zoom level of your website-to-PDF conversions using the scale parameter with Microlink API automated browser.

parameters.name: pdf.width
parameters.description: Set a custom paper width for your PDF generation using pixels, inches, or other CSS units. Fine-tune the horizontal dimensions of your website-to-PDF conversions.

parameters.name: ping
parameters.description: Validate the accessibility of all URLs extracted in the response payload. The ping parameter verifies that links to images, videos, or audio are publicly reachable.

parameters.name: prerender
parameters.description: Optimize how content is fetched from the target URL by choosing between a headless browser or a simple HTTP request.

parameters.name: proxy
parameters.description: Bypass IP rate limits, CAPTCHAs, and regional restrictions using high-quality proxy rotation.

parameters.name: retry
parameters.description: Configure the number of exponential backoff retries to attempt if the underlying browser encounters an unexpected internal error.

parameters.name: screenshot
parameters.description: Generate high-fidelity screenshots of any website with a single API call. Automatically handle headless browser infrastructure to extract visual data.

parameters.name: screenshot.animated
parameters.description: Record a website as a short video instead of a static image. Capture animations, transitions and live content as an H.264 MP4 with a single API call.

parameters.name: screenshot.codeScheme
parameters.description: Beautify HTML and JSON content with professional code syntax highlighting using the codeScheme parameter. Choose from popular Prism themes like Darcula or provide a custom CSS URL.

parameters.name: screenshot.element
parameters.description: Capture a specific DOM element as a screenshot by providing a CSS selector. The Microlink API automatically waits for the element to be visible before rendering the image.

parameters.name: screenshot.fullPage
parameters.description: Capture a high-resolution screenshot of the entire scrollable content of a website. Use the fullPage parameter to render the complete layout of a URL.

parameters.name: screenshot.omitBackground
parameters.description: Generate transparent screenshots by omitting the default white background of the webpage.

parameters.name: screenshot.overlay
parameters.description: Create professional screenshot compositions with customizable browser overlays and backgrounds.

parameters.name: screenshot.quality
parameters.description: Control JPEG compression for website screenshots. Set quality between 0 and 100 to balance file size and visual fidelity.

parameters.name: screenshot.type
parameters.description: Choose between JPEG or PNG file formats for your website screenshots. Assets are automatically optimized and served in modern formats based on client device capabilities.

parameters.name: scripts
parameters.description: Inject custom JavaScript into a webpage before it is rendered or captured.

parameters.name: scroll
parameters.description: Navigate to specific sections of a webpage by scrolling to a DOM element matching a CSS selector.

parameters.name: staleTtl
parameters.description: Optimize API performance by serving cached content while simultaneously refreshing it in the background.

parameters.name: styles
parameters.description: Inject custom CSS into a webpage before it is rendered or captured. The styles parameter supports both inline CSS rules and absolute URLs to external stylesheets.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Define the maximum duration allowed for the API to process a request before timing out. The timeout parameter accepts values in milliseconds or human-readable formats.

parameters.name: ttl
parameters.description: Define the cache expiration time for your requests to balance data freshness and response speed. The ttl parameter supports human-readable formats.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The primary address of the website you want to process. The url parameter is the core requirement for any Microlink API request, serving as the base for metadata extraction.

parameters.name: video
parameters.description: Detect and extract direct video source URLs from any website in a browser-friendly format.

parameters.name: viewport
parameters.description: Customize the browser visible area and device capabilities to control how a website is rendered.

parameters.name: waitForSelector
parameters.description: Pause browser execution until a specific element is present in the DOM. The waitForSelector parameter ensures that dynamic content is fully rendered before extracting data.

parameters.name: waitForTimeout
parameters.description: Force the headless browser to wait for a specific duration before capturing or extracting data from the target URL.

parameters.name: waitUntil
parameters.description: Fine-tune when Microlink considers a page fully "loaded" by waiting for specific lifecycle events.

200.description: The data extracted from the target URL.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: An API key issued at https://microlink.io/pricing. Required by the pro endpoint.

Status.description: The outcome of the request, as defined by JSend. `success` pairs with a 2xx status code, `fail` with a 4xx and `error` with a 5xx.

ErrorCode.description: The machine-readable reason the request failed. Each code is documented at https://microlink.io/docs/api/basics/error-codes.

Metadata.description: The data extracted from the target URL.

author.description: A human-readable representation of the author's name.

date.description: ISO 8601 date the content was published.

description.description: The publisher's chosen description of the content.

publisher.description: A human-readable representation of the publisher's name.

title.description: The publisher's chosen title of the content.

url.description: The canonical URL of the content.

image.description: A media asset: an absolute URL plus its contextual metadata.

size_pretty.description: File size in a human readable format.

duration.description: Source duration in seconds, for playable media.

duration_pretty.description: Source duration in a human readable format.

text.description: The page content converted to plain text.

html.description: The rendered HTML of the page.

Redirect.description: One hop of the redirect chain followed from the target URL.

statusCode.description: The HTTP status code returned by the target URL.

headers.description: The HTTP response headers returned by the target URL.

ErrorResponse.description: The typed error model. `code` is the contract: it is stable, enumerable and safe to branch on. `data` maps the offending parameter to a human-readable explanation, and is written for people, not for parsers.

data.description: The offending parameter mapped to an explanation of what is wrong with it.

message.description: A human-readable explanation of the failure.

id.description: The unique identifier of the request that failed.

more.description: The documentation for this error code.

report.description: A prefilled report for this exact request.
